verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Ezra 4

Adversaries = descendants of the Assyrian deportees (2 Kgs 17:33); 4:4–23 is a topical overview of opposition reaching into Nehemiah's time; Ahasuerus = Xerxes (485–465), Artaxerxes = Artaxerxes I (464–424); 4:8–6:18 in Aramaic; the letter concerns the city and its walls, not the Temple, which "had been standing for half a century" (Kidner); 4:24 resumes the thread of 4:5 (Kidner); the work stopped "some 15 years"
